title: Excellent trip well worth it
text: Karlos the guide was fantastic explained lots of facts and so was the driver as the roads were narrow. Full day visiting White Villages & Rhonda amazing places well worth a visit. Excellent experience 5*
author: Michelle_J

title: Jesus's leads us!
text: Great trip with a knowledgeable and fun guide, who was our personal Jesus 😄
author: Y5924KPstuartr

title: Just stunning...
text: One of the most beautiful days of my holiday! Pedro was an excellent driver and Antonio was extremely knowlegeable and made sure everyone was very well taken care of. I would highly recommend this trip!
author: brendacampbel

title: Everything was perfect, the landscapes were breathtaking and the professionalism of our guide made all the difference
text: Wonderful...everything as agreed. Our guide Manuel was perfect... kind and attentive, he shared a lot of information with the group, making our tour extremely rich.
author: silviadP1644HZ

title: Great tour
text: We enjoyed our tour a lot. Our guide, Manuel was perfect, extremely knowledgeable, he made our tour very interesting. On our way he provided information about all aspects of life in the given region. He could speak about olive trees , olive oil, farming and ham, and the history of that region as well. The local food, he recommended , was also very delicious. Although it was raining heavily, we did not mind it! Ronda and the white villages were really worth it! All in all Manuel and the driver were great, we can highly recommend them!
author: annavU317OD

title: Great Day in the Mountains outside Sevilla
text: Great day - loved visiting the White Villages and exploring their charm - Ronda was fun to see - a bit touristy but still enjoyed the experience.  Our guide Luis was the best - great driver, interesting person and extremely knowledgeable - he made the trip very enjoyable.
author: allennyc

title: Marvellous Day touring the Andalusian white villages
text: The trip was wonderful. Driss was a fantastic tour guide. He explained the history of Andalucia, the olive oil making process when we visited the processing plant,   and gave us an overview of the villages we visited. The driver was very pleasant and drove carefully and there was no waiting for pick ups. Driss was very happy to answer any questions. His happy personality made the day a fun one for all of us. I had never been on a tour before and I have to say when I arrived back in Seville I felt I had had a marvellous day out. Thank you.
author: janicemM3321JG

title: A once in a lifetime experience
text: Thanks to our lovely guide Driss and our reliable driver Antonio we had a great and exciting day from beginning to end. Our group of about 9 people from all around the world became a little family and our guide Driss took very good care of us. He took us to breathtaking, fairytale-like places and let each of us feel as a part of our group. He could speak some words in each language and was very interested in everyone enjoying the tour. title: The beauty and richness of Ronda, brought to life by our wonderful guides

title: Overall, the experience...
text: Overall, the experience was fine. I just wish we would’ve spent less time at the first two stops and focused with more time at Ronda alone. Our tour guide was helpful, but was limited based upon length of stays at each place.
